modules.name: Gekokujo
modules.author: Marty Olson (marty4286)
modules.summary: Total conversion set in Sengoku-era Japan.
modules.description:
Gekokujo takes Warband to Sengoku-era Japan: clans fight for the country with ashigaru and samurai, bows and guns, and lords carry their historical banners.

Version 3.0 adds an opening mission, freelancing with promotion from ashigaru to samurai, agents (ninja) that open castle walls, basic battle formations for the AI, sea routes with sea battles, forts with free storage and recruits, and a detailed map from Kyushu to Ezo with Ikko temple fortresses. Weapons, armour, clothing, music and scenes are new or reworked.

The mod is in English only: in other languages, text it did not translate shows Native's translation.
modules.notes: Apply the World map patch from the module's Patches window.
